name: クノイチの刀
notes: Imagegen reference → local TRELLIS-2 dense reconstruction → bounded feature-weighted Taubin smoothing and QEM. No primitive replacement.

Static rigid equipment; no unnecessary bones or clips. Character animation drives the verified Grip.R attachment. Grip contact and combat review recorded separately.
